'''Gthyk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] who served in the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]] in cooperation with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]], she was stationed at [[Dorn Base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where she operated the small [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] there.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gthyk appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Cantina Vendor for Imperial players on Hoth.<ref name="TOR" />
